user.description: Charging sessions are recorded once a wallbox and at least one vehicle have been added.

data_description.update_interval_s: How often live entities publish. Between 15 and 300 seconds
data_description.solar_valuation: How the solar share of a home charge is valued
data_description.geocoding_enabled: Look up an address for external charging sessions from their coordinates
data_description.geocoding_url: The geocoding service endpoint. Preset to Nominatim, freely changeable
data_description.geocoding_contact: Sent as the contact in the User-Agent. Required while geocoding is enabled
data_description.estimate_uncertain_threshold_pct: Below this state-of-charge delta, an estimate counts as uncertain
data_description.grid_power: Entity reporting the grid balance, positive on import, negative for export. Alternative to grid import and grid export
data_description.grid_power_inverted: Enable if the entity reports import as a negative value
data_description.grid_import: Entity reporting grid import, always positive. Alternative to grid power
data_description.grid_export: Entity reporting grid export, always positive. Used together with grid import
data_description.price_grid: Entity reporting the grid price in €/kWh. Alternative to a fixed price
data_description.price_grid_fixed: Fixed grid price in €/kWh. Alternative to an entity
data_description.price_feed_in: Entity reporting the feed-in tariff in €/kWh. Alternative to a fixed price
data_description.price_feed_in_fixed: Fixed feed-in tariff in €/kWh. Alternative to an entity

error.update_interval_out_of_range: Update interval must be between 15 and 300 seconds.
error.geocoding_contact_required: A contact is required while geocoding is enabled.
error.estimate_uncertain_threshold_out_of_rang: Must be greater than 0 and at most 100.
error.grid_source_conflict: Grid power and grid import/export are alternatives; set only one.
error.price_source_conflict: Choose either an entity or a fixed value, not both.

error.start_debounce_out_of_range: Start debounce must be between 0 and 30 seconds.
error.identification_window_out_of_range: Identification window must be between 0 and 300 seconds.
error.energy_counter_required: At least one energy counter, total or session, is required.

details.title: Add vehicle
details.description: Current value reported by the wallbox's identification entity: {identification_hint}. Some wallboxes report only the end of the full serial number printed on the card; if so, prepend the missing leading part by hand when entering a card below. Matching happens against the end of the stored value.

data.name: Name
data.identify_by_vehicle_api: Identify via the vehicle's own integration

data_description.is_guest: Records charging sessions for vehicles without connected telemetry
data_description.vin: Kept out of every state and log entry
data_description.capacity_kwh: Required unless this is a guest vehicle
data_description.cost_mode: Selectable for a planned billing feature that can take a fixed charging price per vehicle into account. The choice has no direct effect on data collection

data_description.energy_session: Energy reported by the vehicle for the current session
data_description.location: Device tracker entity of the vehicle
data_description.charge_end: Estimated charge end, as a timestamp or a string
data_description.charge_power: Charging power reported by the vehicle - display only

delete_all_data.description: Permanently deletes every stored charging session of every year.

confirm.description: Must be set to true. The deletion cannot be undone.

role_entity_removed.title: Assigned entity removed
role_entity_removed.description: The entity assigned to the {role} role of "{subentry_title}" was removed from the entity registry. Assign a new entity to this role.

role_unit_changed.title: Unit changed
role_unit_changed.description: The entity assigned to the {role} role of "{subentry_title}" now reports a different unit than when it was assigned. The role is not read until this is resolved. Open the role's dialog and re-select the entity to confirm the new unit.

unknown_mapping_value.title: Unrecognized raw value
unknown_mapping_value.description: The {role} role of "{subentry_title}" reported the raw value "{raw_value}", which the assigned device's mapping does not know. This is resolved by an updated mapping in the integration, not by a manual assignment.

mapping_source_below_min_version.title: Mapping source outdated or missing
mapping_source_below_min_version.description: The source integration for "{device}", chosen for "{subentry_title}", is not installed or older than {integration_name} {min_version}. Data collection continues; update or install the source integration to resolve this.
